top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are a physical-chemical design achievement: pH-dependent headgroup charge and bilayer-to-non-bilayer phase behaviour govern entrapment of polyanionic nucleic acid and endosomal release. The principle was established by design in Vancouver, its consequences (siRNA therapy, mRNA vaccines) are already delivered at scale, and the 2023 Medicine prize honoured the cargo modification, not the vehicle. A narrow citation on ionizable lipid design for nucleic-acid encapsulation makes Cullis, Hope and Madden defensible, though excluding MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer is a real cost. Next I place the mature, cleanly attributed C-N coupling alone, then the C-N plus base editing pairing, which is uneven in maturity, then base editing alone, whose clinical record is short; no award is last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; B016 lipid self-assembly overlaps with my own research field but no personal tie to the candidates is evident
